note: Reference clips for visual checks. Files land in ref-clips/ (git-ignored): 'npm run filmstrip clips' downloads the ones with a url and records the synthetic ones in the browser. 'at' is the default moment (seconds) a filmstrip starts from.

clips.role: known truth: square that moves, stops 3.5-8.5 s, moves on; disc heading 30 degrees down-right; disc heading left
the same scene under heavy sensor noise
still patch with a 1.2 Hz brightness swing of about one level, for magnify
fast motion: branches in strong wind, static camera
slow drift: clouds in a timelapse
low light: people walking by the water at night
handheld camera: a crowd walking, the whole frame wobbles
a face held nearly still, locked camera: for magnify (pulse)
a real 60 fps source: fast vehicles, near-static camera
two directions of movers: motorway traffic, static camera
